PDK: Process Design Kit. Foundry files defining a semiconductor manufacturing process: device models, design rules, and standard cell libraries. LibreLane supports open PDKs including sky130, gf180mcu, and ihp-sg13g2.
SCL: Standard Cell Library. Pre-characterized logic gates such as NAND gates and flip-flops that the synthesizer maps your RTL onto, including timing, area, and power metrics for each cell.
RTL: Register-Transfer Level. Verilog or SystemVerilog hardware descriptions defining registers and combinational logic between them. The primary input to the flow.
GDSII: Final stream format file sent to the foundry, defining every geometric polygon across each mask layer.
synthesis: Translates RTL into a structural gate-level netlist of standard cells, performed by Yosys.
STA: Static Timing Analysis. Verifies path timing across process corners without dynamic simulation, calculating setup and hold slack.
WNS: Worst Negative Slack. Slack on the most critical timing path. Negative values indicate timing failure requiring logic optimization or frequency reduction.
TNS: Total Negative Slack. Sum of negative slack across all failing endpoints, measuring cumulative timing closure difficulty.
setup: Setup timing requirement: data must arrive at a sequential cell before the clock edge. Violations indicate the data path is too slow.
hold: Hold timing requirement: data must remain stable briefly after the clock edge. Hold violations are resolved by inserting delay buffers.
DRC: Design Rule Check. Verifies layout geometries satisfy foundry spacing, width, and enclosure rules, evaluated with Magic and KLayout.
LVS: Layout Versus Schematic. Confirms the extracted layout netlist matches the structural design netlist, evaluated with Netgen.
antenna: Antenna effect: long metal lines collect charge during plasma etching that can damage gate oxides. Mitigated using antenna diode insertion.
XOR: Mask XOR verification: compares two layout databases (such as Magic and KLayout GDS exports) to confirm geometric identity.
EQY: Equivalence Checking (Yosys EQY). Formally verifies that the synthesized netlist matches RTL logic behavior across all state spaces.
utilization: Fraction of core area occupied by standard cells. Higher utilization yields smaller dies but increases routing congestion.
PDN: Power Distribution Network. Metal rings, straps, and rails distributing power and ground supply voltages to cells.
floorplan: Stage defining die boundaries, core margins, IO pin placement, and power grids prior to cell placement.
placement: Stage assigning physical coordinates on row grids for every standard cell instance.
CTS: Clock Tree Synthesis. Builds balanced buffer trees to deliver clock signals to all flip-flops with minimal skew.
routing: Stage connecting standard cell and macro pins using metal wires on designated routing layers.
slack: Timing margin relative to the required clock edge. Positive values meet timing; negative values violate constraints.
corner: Operating condition combining process variations, voltage levels, and temperatures (PVT) for signoff timing checks.
wirelength: Total length of routed interconnect metal, directly correlating with area, routing congestion, and dynamic power.
DSE: Design Space Exploration. Runs multiple flow configurations with varied parameter sets to identify optimal timing, area, and power tradeoffs.
